title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp uses compressible conservative ideal-gas state and report.tex:44–53 gives Euler and viscous formulation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured cell/face geometry and boundary family mapping, root METIS partition and owned/ghost local geometry are implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:465–520 sums oriented face residual and MPI global norms; :1029 records first-order steady residual, and most steady updates use first order as disclosed.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: main.cpp face_flux uses Rusanov local Lax–Friedrichs; it is diffusive compared with less dissipative approximate Riemann solvers.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: main.cpp:487–505 handles slip/no-slip wall conditions and wall gradients; surface rows report boundary states as documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:981–987 activates limited high-order on only first inner sweep of every 25th steady step; most steady updates and final residual :1029 are first-order. Report.tex:46–47 explicitly discloses this schedule; transient uses high order.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Steady limited high-order face states active only first inner sweep each25th outer step, with positivity backtracking; transient limiter coefficient is unity and admissibility fallback active, explicitly disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:628–638 projects one-sided wall shear tangentially. The strongly elevated NACA viscous drag warrants accuracy concern; exact source/binary attribution remains qualified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local block-Jacobi CFL march implemented; steady stop main.cpp:1051–55 checks residual target without checking both force histories.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:926–976 uses full BDF residual and rejects target misses. Attempt metadata reports zero misses and history supports t=300 periodic lift; exact historical binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partitions and neighbour exchange; np1/8 historic NACA Cd0.0658569/0.0658558 and Re20 Cd4.70139/4.70140 are close.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
